mentions.name: Music Festivals AI
mentions.description: This web app helps users find music festivals near them by scrolling around an interactive map and filtering by month, covering both local events and destinations they plan to travel to. The map view works best on desktop, with a mobile view available via the map icon in the header.
mentions.problem: The builder couldn't find any great existing tools for discovering music festivals on a map filtered by month, so they built one.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://musicfestivals.ai - find music festivals near you.

I wanted to be able to scroll around a map and filter by month to see what festivals were happening around me and places I wanted to travel, but I couldn't find any great existing tools for this, so I built this thing.
